title: Pushouts along closed immersions of finite type preserve finite type over a locally Noetherian base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: In Situation relative-pushout-along-closed-immersion-and-integral (the chapter's standing diagram with Z -> X a closed immersion and Z -> Y integral), when S is locally Noetherian and X, Y, Z are locally of finite type over S, the pushout Y amalgam Z X produced by the chapter's existence proposition is locally of finite type over S. The retained proof is written: looking on affine opens recovers More on Algebra, lemma fibre-product-finite-type (the fibered-product-of-rings finiteness statement behind the pushout construction), quoted by name; the affine-open inspection is the entire scheme-side argument. Retained author proof at lines 19870-19873.
